<subject>Re: Need to pay Synlab invoice by COB Tues 11/27.    NOTICE OF SYNLAB  SERVICE AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO SYNLAB IS OVERDUE</subject>
<body>
Alain -- My understanding was that Lumière Santé had settled Synlab's credit terms last week; however, below is a notice that the invoice remains unpaid and Lumière Santé will be suspended from lab supply services if payment is not received by 11/27 COB.

Please advise if Clinical Operations needs to contact Synlab to negotiate. Jacqueline 37007.
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message----- 
From: Cousin, Richard 
Sent: Wed 11/19/2025 9:20 AM 
To: Guilbert, Jacqueline; Robin, Philippe 
Cc: Boulay, Hugues; Laine, Emmanuel 
Subject: FW: [ORG_3] AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th PAYMENT TO SYNLAB IS OVERDUE



FYI 

-----Original Message----- 
From: d992@pexcorcorp.com [<mailto:d992@pexcorcorp.com>] 
Sent: Tuesday, November 18, 2025 8:43 PM 
To: helene.pruvost@lumieresante.fr; victor.hoarau@lumieresante.fr 
Cc: d742@sollumlabs.com; l184@sollumlabs.com 
Subject: [ORG_3] AGREEMENT BREACH - November 18th 
PAYMENT TO SYNLAB IS OVERDUE 
Importance: High 


> This is your formal notice that Synlab now considers your company in breach of 
> the Synlab [ORG_4] for non-payment of your November 5, 2025 Synlab 
> invoice by 1 p.m. today. In accordance with the current provisions of Section 
> 15.1.3 of Synlab's [ORG_4], you have three business days to rectify 
> this breach by making full payment to Synlab. If this breach is not rectified by 
> the end of Synlab's business day on Tuesday, November 25, 2025, Synlab will declare 
> your company in default and terminate your rights to participate at Synlab 
> committee meetings, to transact business in Synlab's supply network, and to receive 
> diagnostic reagents from Synlab. Additionally, all Synlab Partners will receive a 
> list tomorrow of companies that did not pay their invoice for October activity 
> on the due date. 
> 
> If you have any questions regarding this notice or the amount your company 
> owes to Synlab, please contact Margot Ferreira at +33 4 19 32 69 07 or Olivie Le Roux at 
> +33 4 71 47 75 05. 
> 
> Suzanne Daugherty 
> Controller 
</quoted>
